text: {"label": "Pediatric Feeding Disorder Assessment and Treatment","definition": "Broad work on assessing and treating pediatric feeding disorders, including overviews, reviews, training, reinforcement and physical guidance procedures, packing, relapse, treatment dropout, and efficiency of intensive feeding treatment.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Covers pediatric feeding disorders as a whole field, rather than food selectivity in autism, extinction-based treatment of food refusal, or functional analysis of inappropriate mealtime behavior."}
